description: Source code implementing ASN.1 configuration helpers for NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) in 5G NR, including functions to create and populate configuration structures based on input parameters.

methods.name: ocudu::odu::make_asn1_rrc_cell_sib19
methods.description: Creates and populates a sib19_r17_s structure based on provided sib19_info parameters, including NTN configuration.

methods.name: ocudu::odu::make_asn1_rrc_cell_ntn_cfg
methods.description: Constructs an ntn_cfg_r17_s structure from ntn_config input, setting various fields such as epoch time, validity duration, polarization, ephemeris info, and TA report.
